title: ‘Grown Man’ Finds Himself Locked Up on Burglary Charges While on Parole
description:
An Illinois man was chased down by Homewood police after citizens reported a car burglary in the neighborhood. Marco Wilson, who referred to himself as a “grown man” while simultaneously complaining, allegedly tried his best to ditch his firearm and any evidence of a crime while running from police. He was charged with one count of being an armed habitual criminal, felony burglary, and three counts of resisting arrest. His case is still pending.
